summary: AnythingLLM publishes one quantitative performance claim, 'reducing token usage by up to 80% per query' with Intelligent Skill Selection (README.md:69, repeated as a runtime log hint in server/utils/agents/aibitat/index.js:938). It links to the product docs site, but the repo contains no benchmark, eval script, dataset, or result data behind it. There are no bench/, evals/, or results directories, and the test suites are functional unit tests only, so nothing about its performance is reproducible from the repo.
result_focus_note: manual classification of published_results: outcome = does the tool do its job; engineering = speed of the software itself
